subject.title: Feature: Support Telegram media groups (albums) in message tool

question: Should Telegram album support be automatic for existing `sendMessage`/`mediaUrls` payloads, exposed as a new explicit `send-media-group`/`filePaths` action, or supported through both with a documented contract?
rationale: Current main already carries multiple media URLs through the standard send path, while the open draft introduces a parallel action and parameter; choosing this contract affects tool prompting, docs, fallback behavior, and plugin API stability.

options.title: Use Existing mediaUrls
options.body: Implement automatic `sendMediaGroup` for eligible multi-media `sendMessage`/`mediaUrls` payloads and fall back to existing sequential sends for non-groupable cases.

options.title: Accept Explicit Album Action
options.body: Sponsor a separate `send-media-group` action only if maintainers want album sending to be opt-in and separately documented from normal sends.

options.title: Defer API Shape
options.body: Keep the issue open and ask the draft PR author to pause until maintainers choose the permanent message-tool contract.

recommendation.title: Use Existing mediaUrls
recommendation.body: Implement automatic `sendMediaGroup` for eligible multi-media `sendMessage`/`mediaUrls` payloads and fall back to existing sequential sends for non-groupable cases.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already drove the prior cleanup review and has the strongest recent routing signal for the Telegram action/runtime decision.
